s.note: David's job as a stadium security guard
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Shape into pretzels, dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes, brush with butter and serve with yellow mustard.

Slice 2 purple sweet potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and soak in cold water for 20 minutes. Drain and dry very well on tea towels. Fry in small batches in oil at 160C for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until the bubbling slows and they crisp up. Drain on paper towel and season straight away with sea salt and a pinch of smoked paprika. Cool so they crisp fully.

m.n: Weight room rump with garlic butter
m.note: David lifting more than he ever knew he could
m.how: Roast 1kg potato chunks tossed in oil and salt at 220C for 45 minutes. Mash 80g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley. Season 4 x 250g rump steaks and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side for medium, then rest 5 minutes. Blanch 300g green beans for 3 minutes and toss with a little butter. Top each steak with a slice of the garlic butter.

w.n: Mr Glass lemon and berry jelly
w.note: Mr Glass and his fragile bones
w.how: Warm 500ml water with the juice of 3 lemons and 120g sugar. Soak 5 gelatine sheets, squeeze and stir in until dissolved. Divide 125g blueberries and 125g raspberries among round glasses and pour over the jelly. Chill for 4 hours until clear and set.

d.how: Simmer a 5cm piece of sliced ginger in 1L water for 5 minutes, then take off the heat and let it cool for 2 minutes. Add 4 green tea bags and steep for 3 minutes, then remove. Stir in 4 tbsp honey and the juice of 1 lemon. Pour into 4 mugs with a lemon slice each. Add 30ml whisky to any mug where it's wanted.
